item.title: Sigourney Weaver Looking To Join Live-Action TOMB RAIDER Series Starring Sophie Turner
item.description: With Sigourney Weaver wrapping up her time on Pandora in the Avatar franchise, it looks like she might already be lining up her next adventure. According to Deadline, the iconic actor is in talks to join the upcoming live action Tomb Raider series at Prime Video. A deal has not been finalized, but the possibility will have fans imagining Weaver stepping into another massive franchise. The series is set to star Sophie Turner as Lara Croft with Phoebe Waller Bridge writing and executive producing.
